Sub 'PrintData'
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
For each trnscalendarioletivo order calData when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (calData) when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True order calAno when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (calAno) when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True order calDescricao when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (calDescricao) when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True order calDiautil when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (calDiautil) when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True order calFeriado when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (calFeriado) when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True order calStatus when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (calStatus) when &OrderedBy = 6 AND &OrderedDsc = True
using trnscalendarioletivoWWDS(&DynamicFiltersSelector1, &DynamicFiltersOperator1, &calDescricao1, &calData1, &calData_To1, &calDiautil1 , &calFeriado1, &DynamicFiltersEnabled2, &DynamicFiltersSelector2, &DynamicFiltersOperator2, &calDescricao2, &calData2 , &calData_To2, &calDiautil2, &calFeriado2, &DynamicFiltersEnabled3, &DynamicFiltersSelector3, &DynamicFiltersOperator3 , &calDescricao3, &calData3, &calData_To3, &calDiautil3, &calFeriado3, &TFcalAno , &TFcalAno_To, &TFcalData, &TFcalData_To, &TFcalDescricao, &TFcalDescricao_Sel, &TFcalDiautil_Sels , &TFcalFeriado_Sels, &TFcalStatus_Sels) Where prefCodigo = &prefCodigo &calDiautilDescription = '' Do Case Case calDiautil.ToString().Trim() = !"S" &calDiautilDescription = "Sim"
Case calDiautil.ToString().Trim() = !"N" &calDiautilDescription = "Não"
EndCase &calFeriadoDescription = '' Do Case Case calFeriado.ToString().Trim() = !"S" &calFeriadoDescription = "Sim"
Case calFeriado.ToString().Trim() = !"N" &calFeriadoDescription = "Não"
EndCase &calStatusDescription = '' Do Case Case calStatus.ToString().Trim() = !"A" &calStatusDescription = "Ativo"
Case calStatus.ToString().Trim() = !"I" &calStatusDescription = "Inativo"
EndCase
Do 'BeforePrintLine' print printBlockLines_data Do 'AfterPrintLine' EndFor
